translations.web: “By reason of the multitude of oppressions they cry out. They cry for help by reason of the arm of the mighty.
translations.bsb: Men cry out under great oppression; they plead for relief from the arm of the mighty.
translations.kjv: By reason of the multitude of oppressions they make the oppressed to cry: they cry out by reason of the arm of the mighty.
translations.asv: By reason of the multitude of oppressions they cry out; They cry for help by reason of the arm of the mighty.
